FORT VALLEY STATE UNIVERSITY (FVSU), a state and land-grant institution of the University System of Georgia, invites applications for the position of Research Assistant- Agricultural Electronic Engineering Technology.

Fort Valley State University, the only 1890 land-grant university in Georgia, is a comprehensive institution that provides an education to over 2,800 students including graduate students. The university is located in the town of Fort Valley in Peach County, the original site of the state's peach industry. Its 1,365-acre (5.52 km2) campus is Georgia's second-largest public university in area.

Fort Valley State University is an affirmative action, equal opportunity institution and does not discriminate against applicants, students, or employees on the basis of race, gender, ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or marital or veteran status.

Job Summary

The College of Agriculture, Family Sciences and Technology (CAFST) seeks an energetic team-oriented Research Assistant with expertise in Electronic Engineering Technology (EET) for a full-time12-month position.

The Research Assistant will support research and development activities related to Electronic Engineering Technology, including sensing systems, automation, instrumentation, and data acquisition used in modern agricultural production. The successful candidate will assist faculty researchers and engineers with the design, assembly, testing and deployment of electronic systems used in applications such as precision agriculture, environmental monitoring, smart irrigation, greenhouse automation and agricultural robotics.

The Research Assistant will contribute to applied research projects that integrate electronics, embedded systems, sensors and agricultural technologies to improve agricultural productivity, sustainability and resource efficiency.

Duties And Responsibilities

Assist with the design, assembly, and testing of electronic systems and instrumentation used in agricultural research applications.
Support development of embedded systems, microcontroller-based devices, and sensor networks for agricultural monitoring and automation.
Participate in building and integrating hardware systems used in precision agriculture technologies, including soil sensors, climate monitoring systems and automated irrigation controls.
Assist with prototype development and testing of agricultural electronic devices
Install and maintain field-based and greenhouse-based data acquisition systems.
Collect and manage data from sensors measuring environmental variables such as soil moisture, temperature, humidity, light intensity, and nutrient levels.
Support integration of sensors with microcontrollers, data loggers, and wireless communication platforms.
Assist in troubleshooting hardware and software issues related to electronic systems.
Maintain laboratory equipment used for electronics development, including oscilloscopes, multimeters, soldering equipment, and testing tools.
Ensure compliance with laboratory safety procedures and equipment maintenance protocols.
Assist with data analysis and visualization using spreadsheets or analytical software.
Support preparation of technical reports, research publications, and grant documentation
Work collaboratively with faculty, engineers, technicians on interdisciplinary research projects
Support preparation of materials for workshops, extension programming and educational demonstrations.

Knowledge Required By The Position

Basic knowledge of electronic circuits, sensors and instrumentation systems.
Experience with microcontrollers (e.g. Arduino, Raspberry Pi, or similar platforms.
Ability to read electronic schematics and assemble basic electronic components.
Strong organizational and technical documentation skills.
Ability to successfully pass a background check

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in electronic engineering technology, Agricultural Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related field.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with precision agriculture technologies or agricultural automation systems.
Familiarity with sensor networks, wireless communication (LoRa, Zigbee, Wi-Fi) or IoT platforms.
Experience with programming languages such as Python, C/C++, or MATLAB
Knowledge of data acquisition systems and environmental monitoring instrumentation.
Experience working in field-based agricultural research environments

As a TPM for SRE, you will partner with SRE leaders and engineers to scale the platform that underpins all of MongoDB’s cloud products. Lead Cross-Functional Coordination – Align SRE with Security, Compliance, Cloud platform, and other engineering teams. Coordinate cross-team incident response, ensure clear follow-through, and build trust as the go-to driver of complex, multi-team efforts

Strong knowledge of production change management, software development lifecycle, and reliability metrics (SLOs, SLIs)
Skilled at shaping roadmaps and managing dependencies

Excellent communicator—clear, concise, and calm—across engineers, cross-functional partners, and executives
Low-ego, highly collaborative, and motivated by ownership of hard problems end to end

You'll be in the critical path of high-impact projects, working with executive stakeholders, and supported to grow in your career.

About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

As a senior analyst in a well-funded, growth Series C start-up, you will be defining our growth potential for years to come. You will be an integral part of Reserv’s data team, working with our customers to deliver high-fidelity data and insights.

For this role, we are seeking data analysts with strong Python, SQL, and Excel skills. You should be curious about how claims work and how our systems process them. You’ll also need the ability to interface with customers from both technical and non-technical backgrounds, and to work independently while collaborating closely with our engineering and operations teams. If you are ready to help shape the vision for Reserv’s technology, join us on the journey.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

What You Will Do

Work with our data stack: Python (Pandas to NLTK), Postgres/dbt, Looker, Excel, etc.
Lead client calls through technical analysis to provide recommendations and insights
Ship reporting code and improve our data modeling layer to solve for our customers' needs
Work on problems that don’t have a clearly defined answer, often helping define the “right” solution
Communicate ideas and specifications through detailed, precise writing
Influence the culture, values, and processes of a growing engineering team
Enjoy and have fun being creative and thinking outside of the box. You will need to draw on analogous situations you’ve worked on before, but we are not traversing well-traveled roads. “Where we’re going, we don’t need roads!”

Qualifications

6-8 years of experience as an individual contributor with experience using modern analytics and programming languages—we’re in Python and dbt/Postgres every day
A proven ability to interface with high-value customers and communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences alike
Have a strong demonstrated toolkit to build ETLs and net new data visualizations/reports
Have a proven track record of shipping high quality data analysis at a high cadence
A passion for building intuitive technology and a thirst for learning
Able to think through customer requirements and prioritize what is a must-have, nice-to-have, or irrelevant
Have a strong technical skillset but also the willingness and ability to take over tasks outside your core competency

Benefits

Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!
